Write a Rust program that defines a struct with a mutable field, borrows it immutably to read a value, then borrows it mutably to update the value, and asserts the final value matches the expected sum of the initial and updated amounts.
Write a Rust program that wraps a value in a Box, moves the Box into a function, asserts the original variable is no longer accessible, and asserts the function returns the unwrapped value correctly.

Write a Rust program that creates an Rc<T> containing a counter, clones the Rc twice, increments the counter through one clone, and asserts that all three references observe the same final counter value.

Write a Rust program that creates an Arc<Mutex<i32>> containing a value, spawns a thread that locks the mutex to increment the value, and asserts the main thread observes the incremented value after joining the thread.
